name: Comms Group
summary: ASX-listed telecommunications provider (ASX: CCG); acquired TasmaNet from the receivers of Field Solutions Holdings (May 2025) for $10m, gaining TasmaNet's fixed-wireless network, Hobart CBD fibre, and cloud/data centre assets.

events.details: Signed $10m deal (16 May 2025) to acquire TasmaNet's business from Field Solutions' receivers; expected to complete before end-May 2025.
